patterns.comment: Non-standard C-style block comment. Not part of DSPF proper (which uses '*'/'**'), retained as an editor convenience for hand-annotated files.
patterns.name: comment.block.dspf

patterns.comment: Non-standard C++-style line comment. Not part of DSPF proper, retained as an editor convenience for hand-annotated files.
patterns.name: comment.line.double-slash.dspf

patterns.comment: Double-asterisk line comment, the DSPF-preferred convention per the SPF spec.
patterns.name: comment.line.double-asterisk.dspf

patterns.comment: Bare SPICE comment: a leading '*' followed by whitespace or end-of-line. The lookahead excludes '*|' annotations and header keywords such as *DSPF, which have no space after the asterisk.
patterns.name: comment.line.asterisk.dspf

patterns.comment: Ground net declaration; group 2 colors the rail name. The pipe is optional because vendors emit both *|GROUND_NET and *GROUND_NET.
Header keywords. BUS_DELIMITER precedes DELIMITER so the trailing \b never truncates it. The optional pipe covers both *|DESIGN and *DESIGN vendor spellings.
patterns.name: keyword.control.dspf.heading

patterns.comment: Net section header; group 2 colors the net name and the trailing capacitance is left to the numeric rule. Covers *|NET and bare *NET.
Net connectivity labels: *|I instance pin, *|P port/pin, *|S subnode. The \b keeps single letters from bleeding into following identifiers.
patterns.name: keyword.other.dspf.connection

patterns.comment: Fallback for any other *| vendor annotation not modelled above.
patterns.name: keyword.other.dspf.annotation

patterns.comment: Subcircuit definition. Group 1 is the .SUBCKT keyword and group 2 the subckt/module name; each remaining whitespace-delimited token on the line is a top-level port. Ports reappear as *|P declarations in the net sections.
Subcircuit terminators, case-insensitive. ENDS precedes END so it is not truncated.
patterns.name: keyword.control.dspf.subckt

patterns.comment: Parasitic element instance name: R resistor, C capacitor, L inductor. The whole identifier (e.g. C_OUT_1, R25) is one token, matching SPICE naming where the leading letter is only a type hint, not a separable field.
patterns.name: entity.name.dspf.element

patterns.comment: Instance-section subcircuit call (e.g. X1 X1:A X1:Y VDD VSS INVX1): the instance name comes first, then instance-pin/node terminals in instance:pin form, then the subcircuit master/cell name as the final field. The master rule anchors on end-of-line so only the last token is scoped as the cell.
Subcircuit master/cell name: the final field on the line.
patterns.name: entity.name.type.dspf.cell

patterns.comment: Device instance line (MOSFET M, and other single-letter SPICE devices). Light-touch: color the instance name only; terminals, model and parameters fall through to the generic token rules rather than a full SPICE device grammar.
patterns.name: entity.name.function.dspf.instance

patterns.comment: Layout parameters emitted by extraction tools, e.g. $w=, $l=, $layer=, $X=.

Delimited name: the part after the DELIMITER ':' is the pin (in instance:pin) or the sub-node index (in net:sub). It is scoped as an identifier, never a pin-type keyword. The instance/net part before the colon is left to the catch-all so the whole reads as one name:name unit.
Standalone DELIMITER colon (e.g. the value of *|DELIMITER, or a trailing colon) not followed by a name.
patterns.name: punctuation.separator.delimiter.dspf

patterns.comment: Numeric bus bit/range, e.g. [1], <0:7>, (3).
Remaining brackets, including the parentheses wrapping *|P/*|I/*|S argument lists.
patterns.name: punctuation.definition.bracket.dspf

patterns.comment: Numbers including decimals and scientific notation, e.g. 0.148478e-12 or 1.70333E00. No trailing word boundary so an attached unit suffix (see below) can be scoped separately.
patterns.name: constant.numeric.dspf

patterns.comment: Engineering/unit suffix attached to a value, e.g. 0.148478PF, 1.0u, 44.7OHM. Case-insensitive per SPICE; multi-character units are listed before single-character scale factors.
patterns.name: keyword.other.dspf.unit

patterns.comment: Pin direction/type flags used in *|P and *|I lists: I input, O output, B bidirectional, X unspecified, S supply, J jumper. The lookbehind excludes the letter of a *|I / *|P / *|S label.
patterns.name: keyword.other.dspf.pintype

patterns.comment: Hierarchy divider ('/' or '.') embedded between name segments, e.g. X1.In, or a standalone DIVIDER value.
patterns.name: punctuation.separator.divider.dspf

patterns.comment: Catch-all for net, node and instance names. MUST remain the last pattern, or any rule after it becomes unreachable.
patterns.name: variable.other.dspf
